say:0:1460108001:2.text: After saying farewell to Lyca and the others, you head off to the Ashen Wastes...
say:0:1460108001:2.source_cn: 暂时告别了依依不舍的莱卡他们，你们前往了荒角沙漠……

say:2:1460108002:0.text: So this... is a desert? I've never seen anything like it.
say:2:1460108002:0.source_cn: 这里，就是沙漠吗？我还是第一次见到这种地方。

say:4:1460108003:0.text: The wind bites, the air is bone-dry, and the ground is nothing but sand.
say:4:1460108003:0.source_cn: 风很大，还很干燥——咳咳，还有不少沙子！

choice_prompt:5:1460108003.text: The wind bites, the air is bone-dry, and the ground is nothing but sand.
choice_prompt:5:1460108003.source_cn: 风很大，还很干燥——咳咳，还有不少沙子！

say:6:1460108004:0.text: Yes. The air there clung to the skin, heavy with moisture.
say:6:1460108004:0.source_cn: 是的，空气很多时候都黏黏的，几乎会滴下水珠的程度。

say:7:1460108006:0.text: Back home, the breeze was gentle, the land green and full of life.
say:7:1460108006:0.source_cn: 我的故乡虽然有风，但大多都更轻柔，空气也更潮湿，到处都...

say:8:1460108007:0.text: But here, the wind cuts like steel, and the earth offers no shelter.
say:8:1460108007:0.source_cn: 但是这里却截然不同，目之所及，四处都是黄沙，狂风堪称凌...

say:9:1460108008:0.text:
It's true what they say—reading ten thousand books is no match for walking ten thousand miles._x000D_
And now I understand why. The desert teaches what ink cannot.
say:9:1460108008:0.source_cn: 果然说读万卷书不如行万里路，这样的大漠风光，即使能在画...

choice_prompt:10:1460108008.text:
It's true what they say—reading ten thousand books is no match for walking ten thousand miles._x000D_
And now I understand why. The desert teaches what ink cannot.
choice_prompt:10:1460108008.source_cn: 果然说读万卷书不如行万里路，这样的大漠风光，即使能在画上欣赏，也不如亲身体会。

say:11:1460108009:0.text: It was just a passing thought... Wait.
say:11:1460108009:0.source_cn: 只是些许感想，不值一提……咦？

say:15:1460108011:1.text: Magister, Chippy heard it too! Sounds like fighting nearby!
say:15:1460108011:1.source_cn: 主人，我也听到了，那边好像有争斗声！
say:15:1460108011:1.male: Magister, Chippy heard it too! Sounds like fighting nearby!
say:15:1460108011:1.female: Magister, Chippy heard it too! Sounds like fighting nearby!

say:16:1460108012:0.text: Following the clash of weapons, you spot a group of bandits ambushing a patrol from the Grimmaw Clan.
say:16:1460108012:0.source_cn: 你们循着刀剑交击的声音赶去，发现是一群盗匪，他们兵分两...

say:17:1460108013:0.text: Despite the warriors' efforts, they're slowly being overwhelmed...
say:17:1460108013:0.source_cn: 尽管战士们尽力抵挡，但在盗匪有意的阻拦下，却逐渐落于下风……

say:18:1460108014:1.text: Magister! They're trying to wipe out the entire Grimmaw patrol!
say:18:1460108014:1.source_cn: 主人快看，是盗匪，他们看样子是想吞了整支黑嚎部落的巡逻队！
say:18:1460108014:1.male: Magister! They're trying to wipe out the entire Grimmaw patrol!
say:18:1460108014:1.female: Magister! They're trying to wipe out the entire Grimmaw patrol!

say:19:1460108015:0.text: They can't hold out for much longer—we have to help!
say:19:1460108015:0.source_cn: 盗匪？人数确实不少，还懂分兵，另外一方的战士们坚持不了...

choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 你以前住的地方很湿润？

say:21:1460108005:0.text: Of course. A martial artist adapts—the world itself is a teacher.
say:21:1460108005:0.source_cn: 当然，我毕竟还是个武者，这点不适还是能接受的。

choice:5:1:2.text: Think you'll be okay out here?
choice:5:1:2.male: Think you'll be okay out here?
choice:5:1:2.female: Think you'll be okay out here?
